title: hey guys i need you are help!
author: Queasy-Yam412
selftext:
hey guys i need you are help!

Hey guys, I’m a 20-year-old aspiring Technical Artist specializing in rigging and Unreal Engine.

I have skills in:

* Prop modeling
* Character and mechanical rigging
* Unreal Engine import and IK retargeting
* Basic gameplay setup for characters

Right now, I’m also working a delivery job, but I’m trying to move fully into the game industry.

I’d really appreciate any small support — whether it’s checking out my Fiverr/Upwork, sharing it with others, or even giving feedback on my work.

It would honestly help me a lot.
